map.绩效考核得分归一化与排名 使用指南: Performance Appraisal Score Normalization and Ranking User Guide
map.绩效考核得分归一化与排名工具。输入多员工绩效原始分，归一化后排名并给出等级，用于: The performance appraisal score normalization and ranking tool takes raw scores for multiple employees, ranks them after normalization and assigns grades, for fair ordering and applying appraisal results.
map.不同团队得分量纲不一，按 (得分/最大值)×100 归一到同一标尺。: Different teams use different score scales, so normalize with (score / maximum) x 100 onto a common scale.
map.强制分布前，先看归一分布是否呈双峰再定比例。: Before forcing a distribution, check whether the normalized distribution is bimodal and then set the ratio.
map.晋升短名单按归一分降序截取。: The promotion shortlist takes the top slice by descending normalized score.
map.：A 组最高 85、B 组最高 92；A 组 80 归一 = 80/85×100: Group A tops out at 85 and group B at 92; normalizing 80 in group A gives 80/85 x 100 = about 94.1, while 85 in group B gives 85/92 x 100 = about 92.4, so that employee in group A is relatively stronger.
map.：归一后取前 20% 进晋升池，工具标出临界线。: After normalization, take the top 20% into the promotion pool and the tool marks the cutoff line.

map.用最大值还是均值归一？: Normalize by the maximum or by the mean?
map.最大值归一保留差距更敏感，均值归一更稳定；团队人数少时建议用均值减少极值干扰。: Normalizing by the maximum preserves gaps more sensitively, while normalizing by the mean is more stable; with small teams, the mean reduces outlier interference.
map.不能，归一只解决量纲，评分松紧仍需校准会解决。: No. Normalization only fixes the scale; how strict the scoring feels still requires a calibration meeting.
